title: cheddar RTPQ
description: A simple RTPQ plugin for all PvP servers! Highly customizable!
body:
A simple RTPQ plugin for all PvP servers! Highly customizable!

Global Commands
/rtpq or /rtpqueue - Join the RTP queue
/rtpq leave - Leave the queue
/rtpq status - Check queue status and your position
/rtpq help - Show help information

Admin Commands
/rtpqadmin reload - Reload the plugin configuration
/rtpqadmin setdistance <min> <max> - Set teleportation distance range
/rtpqadmin setplayers <count> - Set number of players required per match
/rtpqadmin queue - Show detailed queue information
/rtpqadmin clear - Clear the entire queue

Permissions
rtpqueue.use - Allows players to use the RTP queue (default: true)
rtpqueue.admin - Allows access to admin commands (default: op)
